[[File:Compound of five truncated tetrahedra.stl|thumb|3D model of a compound of five truncated tetrahedra]]
The '''compound of five truncated tetrahedra''' is a [[uniform polyhedron compound]]. It's composed of 5 [[truncated tetrahedron|truncated tetrahedra]] rotated around a common axis. It may be formed by truncating each of the tetrahedra in the [[compound of five tetrahedra]]. A far-enough truncation creates the [[compound of five octahedra]]. Its convex hull is a nonuniform [[snub dodecahedron]]. It could also be called a truncated chiricosahedron.

== Cartesian coordinates ==
[[Cartesian coordinates]] for the vertices of this compound are all the cyclic permutations of

: (±1, ±1, ±3)
: (±τ<sup>−1</sup>, ±(−τ<sup>−2</sup>), ±2τ)
: (±τ, ±(−2τ<sup>−1</sup>), ±τ<sup>2</sup>)
: (±τ<sup>2</sup>, ±(−τ<sup>−2</sup>), ±2)
: (±(2τ−1), ±1, ±(2τ − 1))

with an even number of minuses in the choices for '±', where τ = (1+{{radic|5}})/2 is the [[golden ratio]] (sometimes written φ).
